name: tomah
description: Tomah International — monorepo: customer storefront (apps/storefront), owner/admin dashboard (apps/web + apps/api), shared data layer (packages/db)
//workspaces: apps/storefront is intentionally NOT a workspace — it is a standalone Vite/vinext app on React 19 with its own lockfile. Vercel builds it with its own `npm install` rooted at apps/storefront.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @tomah/db && npm run build --workspace @tomah/api && npm run build --workspace @tomah/web
